headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red after CAS while Nifty gained 75 points; smallcaps showed resilience.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

summary:

Investors are monitoring crude oil prices, FII activity, and the upcoming three-day banking strike.
